title: diplopterygium deflexum
intro: Diplopterygium deflexum, commonly known as Chinese spleenwort, is a type of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Diplopterygium deflexum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
